**Finding: IP — compliant (no redline proposed).**

This APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement contains no deliverables/work-product or Customer Data IP regime at all, and nothing in it runs against us:

- **Ownership is in our favour, proportionate to investment.** Terminal Parties own and provide their own Segments (4.1); the Wet Segment and Unallocated Capacity are owned "by the Parties in common and undivided shares" per Schedules B/C (4.3, 12.16); we obtain Allocated Capacity "on an ownership basis … in return for their financial investment" (12.2).
- **No conveyance of our title.** IRU sales expressly "do[] not convey ownership" (definition (i)); capacity sales below STM‑1 are on a basis "other than by transfer of ownership" (12.27); intra-group assignments under 22.5 keep costs and ownership aligned.
- **No data licence to a counterparty.** Data and information is addressed only by the mutual confidentiality regime in Paragraph 31, which restricts disclosure rather than granting any Party rights in our information — so there is no Vendor data licence to narrow.
- **Undivided co-ownership of the Wet Segment is the consortium bargain**, not the joint-IP ownership the playbook targets, so we have not flagged it; the absence of licence-back architecture is noted in the rationale only, not as a deviation.
